capabilities: Insert a date-matched reflection into new daily notes automatically
Choose insertion position after properties or at note end
Backfill missing reflections across a date range or all existing daily notes
Preview and remove unchanged plugin-generated reflections
Run fully offline with 366 bundled reflections
disambiguation: The reflections are contemporary writing, not attributed historical quotations.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Mobile compatibility is intended but not yet verified. An optional Ko-fi donation button and a GitHub help link exist; neither sends note content.
problem: Daily notes start as a blank page; this gives each date a short reflection and optional question to begin with.

relations.evidence: If Periodic Notes has daily notes enabled, the bundled helper uses its daily settings instead

summary: Daily-notes companion that inserts a fixed, date-matched reflection into each daily note, working entirely offline with bundled content.
